verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe a Stealth mode that applies anti-detection techniques to bypass bot detection, plus an Ultra Stealth Mode. They also document routing sessions through proxies for geo-restricted content, IP rotation and distribution across locations, which covers the core of the story. One community user reported being instantly blocked by Cloudflare, but the report does not say whether stealth or proxies were enabled, so it lowers confidence rather than creating a dispute. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of residential proxy types, details of fingerprint randomization or country/city geo-targeting parameters, and independent hands-on corroboration that stealth succeeds against bot protection.
